corrections_and_exclusions: Guide incorrectly calls nuclear renewable; uranium is non-renewable.
Guide energy pie chart is undated/historic; replace with dated DUKES 2025 electricity shares for 2024, separate from total energy.
Do not carry forward obsolete 2050 carbon target, subsidy assertions or construction cost forecasts as current facts.
Dryholme retains verified 1 MW and planning estimate about 1,200 homes, not guide 4,000.
Hinkley C is under construction; separate proposed generation from current impacts.
revision_guide_review.scope: Refine existing case studies and explanations; preserve all original notes and Q&A except explicitly updated comparisons.

energy_usage_share_review.basis: UK inland consumption of primary fuels and equivalents for energy use; DUKES 1.1.1.C, energy-supplied percentage shares, calendar year 2025.
energy_usage_share_review.calculation: Individual renewable electricity outputs from DUKES2026 chapter5 converted from TWh to Mtoe at11.63TWh/Mtoe, divided by162.46Mtoe primary consumption; rounded to one decimal. Wave/tidal below0.1%.
energy_usage_share_review.category_scope: Coal includes other solid fuels. The row is labelled Bioenergy and waste to match the official12.6% group. Its renewable classification is mixed because fossil-based waste is not renewable. Net electricity imports1.6% are explained separately.
energy_usage_share_review.display: 2025 usage column is distinct from the explicitly dated2024 electricity-generation chart.
